reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin primarily focused on a right-side workspace file-tree navigation panel, with workspace file opening and an account balance display as supporting features.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 添加右侧工作区文件树侧栏、文件打开功能和账户余额显示。
summaries.en: Adds a right-side workspace file-tree sidebar, workspace file opening, and a DeepSeek account balance display to DeepSeek Harness Web.

capabilities: Adds a right-side workspace file-tree navigation panel
Opens workspace files or folders with the system default application
Retrieves DeepSeek account balance through a server-side credential-backed route
